name: Startups.fyi

sources.title: Homepage — startup-discovery newsletter (claimed 15,592 subscribers); every visible listing card is tagged 'Sponsored'; 'Share your project' links to a Tally form

Tally 'Feature Your Startup' form — Featured Listings start at $29, include permanent directory listing + backlink, ~5 min, manual review; 'listing is not complete until payment has been successfully received'

requirements: Payment required — Featured Listings start at $29; the form explicitly warns unpaid submissions are never published
Manual review: 'Every project is reviewed by a real person to ensure it meets our basic content and quality guidelines'
Form spans 5 pages of fields (page 1 is intro/email); email required for follow-up
preparation: Startup name, URL, description, revenue/MRR figure (listing cards display revenue claims)
workflow: Open the 'Share your project' link on startups.fyi → Tally form tally.so/r/3lOGLk
Listing is reviewed by a human, then published in the searchable directory with a backlink
watchFor: No free route — the entire homepage inventory is sponsored content; organic submissions aren't a thing here
Revenue figures on cards appear self-reported ('Undisclosed', '$650K Pre-revenue' style badges)
Subscriber numbers are self-reported (15.5-15.8k); verify value before paying
Site also sells $49 database access and $199 growth calls — expect upsell collateral
Same operator contact (jr@startups.fyi) appears on Insanely Cool Tools — one person's directory network
countsAsLive: A sponsored product card appears on startups.fyi with a /product/<slug> page and outbound link
unknowns: Exact price tiers above the $29 minimum (form pages 2-5 not fetched)
How long featured placement lasts vs the 'permanent' directory listing
Link type and whether newsletter inclusion is automatic or a separate add-on
